# Jameson Stone

> Personal blog and commonplace book for short notes, archive writing, paintings, and small software projects by Jameson Stone.

Put the AGI in the bag, bro.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://jamesonstone.github.io/): The blog homepage and latest writing.
- [Blog](https://jamesonstone.github.io/blog/): Complete writing archive.
- [Paintings](https://jamesonstone.github.io/paintings/): A small visual archive.
- [Projects](https://jamesonstone.github.io/projects/): Public tools and project records.
- [About](https://jamesonstone.github.io/about/): Profile and contact details.
- [RSS](https://jamesonstone.github.io/feed.xml): Feed for posts.

## Latest Posts

- [Applied Philosophy](https://jamesonstone.github.io/blog/2026/10/25/applied-philosophy.html): A manifesto for treating concepts, premises, and objectives as design material, with consequences that can challenge their justification.
- [Introducing Mint](https://jamesonstone.github.io/blog/2026/10/18/introducing-mint.html): A short introduction to Mint v1.0.0 and its GitHub Actions release workflow.
- [No Sacred Cows in AI](https://jamesonstone.github.io/blog/2026/10/17/no-sacred-cows-in-ai.html): An essay on revisable priors, skills, and the eventual obsolescence of capability scaffolding.
- [The Shallow Expert](https://jamesonstone.github.io/blog/2026/10/12/the-shallow-expert.html): An essay on the gap between producing convincing analysis and understanding its assumptions, consequences, and limits.
- [Implementation is Commoditized](https://jamesonstone.github.io/blog/2026/10/06/implementation-is-commoditized.html): An essay arguing that coding agents have commoditized implementation, removing code as the abstraction layer between PM and engineer and leaving engineers to own domain complexity.

## Public Projects

- [Hyperlite](https://github.com/jamesonstone/hyperlite): A native macOS window and CLI for tracking pull requests, reviews, conflicts, and GitHub Actions across projects.
- [Hyperlite guide](https://github.com/jamesonstone/hyperlite/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md): Application behavior, keyboard shortcuts, and CLI commands.
- [Kit](https://github.com/jamesonstone/kit): A provider-neutral CLI for agent contracts, contextual rules, project memory, and repository validation.
- [Kit getting started](https://github.com/jamesonstone/kit#how-kit-works): How Kit works and commands for new and existing projects.
- [Mint](https://jamesonstone.io/mint/): Semantic versioning, changelogs, and release automation across production, non-production, and sandbox environments.
- [Mint source](https://github.com/jamesonstone/mint): CLI and GitHub Action source repository for Mint.

## Code Projects

- [kit](https://github.com/jamesonstone/kit): A portable, document-first workflow harness for specs, planning, implementation, review, and handoff.
- [yp](https://github.com/jamesonstone/yp): A tiny path-copying CLI for sending files, directories, or picker selections to the clipboard.
- [kp](https://github.com/jamesonstone/kp): A local prompt utility for keeping reusable coding-agent prompts close at hand in the shell.
- [event-collector](https://github.com/jamesonstone/event-collector): An HTTP service and CLI for collecting generic event envelopes with hash validation and idempotency.
- [sso-testkit](https://github.com/jamesonstone/sso-testkit): A Go CLI for checking SSO readiness with scenario files, token-exchange probes, and redacted reports.
- [radar](https://github.com/jamesonstone/radar): A lightweight process observer for agents.
- [mint](https://github.com/jamesonstone/mint): Version, changelog, and release-state tooling.
- [ding](https://github.com/jamesonstone/ding): Invoice payment tracking and workflow tooling.
- [beacon](https://github.com/jamesonstone/beacon): Signal Layer for Coding Agents.
- [flx](https://github.com/jamesonstone/flx): Source Control Rebuilt for the Agentic Era, with Git-Native Interoperability.
- [hyperlite](https://github.com/jamesonstone/hyperlite): NextGen Signal Layer for Coding Agents.
- [rungrid](https://github.com/jamesonstone/rungrid): Unified Development Workspace Observability.
- [ghostgc](https://github.com/jamesonstone/ghostgc): Garbage Collection for Abandoned AI Coding Runtimes.
## Machine Indexes

- [llms.txt](https://jamesonstone.github.io/llms.txt): Curated LLM entrypoint for this site.
